items.title: bug: focus loose of `input` inside `tabs` container in iOS
items.description:
It seems like `input` looses focus when being embedded into the `tabs` container due to an infinite cycle in `TextInputBlock+UIViewRenderable`

- `UICollectionView` inside `TabContentsView` resigns responder right after `reloadData`.
- `reloadData` is triggered because of changing TextInput `isFocus` and `text` properties (oldState != newState)

items.title: Overflow Error When JSON Exceeds Screen Height in Flutter Version
items.description:
Hello,

I have encountered an issue in the Flutter version of DivKit. When the JSON content exceeds the screen height, the screen does not scroll and instead displays an overflow error.


**Steps to Reproduce:**
1. Load a JSON configuration where the content height exceeds the screen height.
2. Observe the overflow error and lack of scrolling.


**Expected Behavior:**
The screen should scroll to accommodate the content that exceeds the screen height.


**Actual Behavior:**
The screen displays an overflow error and does not scroll.


**Screenshots:**
![Screenshot (2)](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/f621f7f7-7288-400e-9e69-ea3d857617a1)


**Environment:**
Flutter version: (3.22.1)


Additional Context:
We are working on integrating DivKit into our project and would like to help resolve this issue. Could you provide guidance on how to fix this problem?

Thank you for your assistance.

Best regards,

items.title: How to access dict value inside expression block is this possible?
items.description:
If I have a variable defined like this 
```
"variables": [
      ...
      {
          "name": "main_value",
          "type": "dict",
          "value": {
              "name": "some name",
              "surname": "some surname"
          }
      }
      ...
    ],
```
How can I access `name` in the expressions? 
`"@{main_value.name}"` for example doesn't work nor 
`"@{main_value[name]}"` nor `"@{main_value['name']}"`
```
 {
    "type": "subtitle",
     "text": "Name: @{main_value.name}",
      "text_color": "#@{text_color_var}",
        "margins": {
            "bottom": 24
       }
 },
 ```
 I cannot find such info inside docs anywhere.
 Thank you in advance for the help
 
 Update: 
 Figured it out from js tests
 `@{getDictString(main_value, 'name')}` is the answer

items.title: How can I subscribe to a variable in my custom view on Android?
items.description:
I'd like to implement a custom native radio group in Android. However, I'm having trouble finding information on how to observe the state variable that is defined in the variables section of the containing card. Here is an example of the state variable definition:

`{
          name: 'checked_index',
          type: 'integer',
          value: 0,
 }`

This variable can be set directly via `Div2View.setVariable()`. But I can't find how to observe changes to update each radio element accordingly.
The `Div2View` class includes a `variableController` property, which appears to be useful. However, it is currently inaccessible from outside the class. 

`
    private val variableController: VariableController?
`

I would appreciate any guidance on how to observe the state variable using the `variableController` or any other available methods or approaches.

items.title: How do you use non-local variables in react?
items.description:
The documentation [https://divkit.tech/en/doc/overview/concepts/variables.html] explains how to use non-local variables in Android but not in React or Web in general. Given that the id field is not used in the HTML, it is not possible to just grab an element and listen for clicks for instance. Ideally you could do this. It would also be great if state could be changed by other parts of the web page which are in another Divkit or not even Divkit, e.g. a React component. 

Many thanks for a great open source product. I tried for weeks to get Adaptive Cards working consistently and couldn't. Where DivKit was easy and just works.
